SELECT p.id ,p.pool_name ,p.pool_type ,p.market_codes ,p.variety_codes ,p.description ,p.max_capacity ,p.batch_in_flow_id ,p.batch_in_flow_key ,p.batch_in_flow_name ,p.batch_out_flow_id ,p.batch_out_flow_key ,p.batch_out_flow_name FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.pool_type = 'crmw'
AND p.id IN
#{poolId}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY p.outer_sort ASC ,p.inner_sort ASC ,p.id ASC

SELECT si.wind_code AS securityCode ,si.short_name AS securityShortName ,si.security_type ,CONCAT_WS(',' ,IF(si.wind_code_sh IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_sh != '', 'SSE', NULL) ,IF(si.wind_code_sz IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_sz != '', 'SZSE', NULL) ,IF(si.wind_code_nib IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_nib != '', 'CIBM', NULL) ,IF(si.wind_code_bj IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_bj != '', 'BSE', NULL) ,IF(si.wind_code_nbc IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_nbc != '', 'OTHER', NULL) ) AS marketCodeText ,ips.crmw_name ,ips.crmw_scode ,ips.crmw_stype ,si.issuer ,si.rating_bond ,si.rating_bondissuer ,si.inner_issuer_rating ,si.maturity_date ,si.date_exists ,si.guarantor ,si.guarantor_id FROM ip_pool_status_crmw ips LEFT JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code
AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.pool_type = 'crmw'
AND ips.security_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityCode}, '%')
AND si.short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityShortName}, '%')
AND ips.crmw_scode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{crmwScode}, '%')
AND ips.crmw_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{crmwName}, '%')
AND (
si.wind_code_sh IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_sh != '' si.wind_code_sz IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_sz != '' si.wind_code_nib IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_nib != '' si.wind_code_bj IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_bj != '' si.wind_code_nbc IS NOT NULL AND si.wind_code_nbc != '' si.security_type = 'company' 1 = 0
)
ORDER BY ips.crmw_scode ASC ,ips.security_code ASC

SELECT bond.wind_code AS securityCode ,bond.short_name AS securityShortName ,bond.security_type ,CONCAT_WS(',' ,IF(bond.wind_code_sh IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_sh != '', 'SSE', NULL) ,IF(bond.wind_code_sz IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_sz != '', 'SZSE', NULL) ,IF(bond.wind_code_nib IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_nib != '', 'CIBM', NULL) ,IF(bond.wind_code_bj IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_bj != '', 'BSE', NULL) ,IF(bond.wind_code_nbc IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_nbc != '', 'OTHER', NULL) ) AS marketCodeText ,crmw.short_name AS crmwName ,crmw.wind_code AS crmwScode ,'crmw' AS crmwStype ,bond.issuer ,bond.rating_bond ,bond.rating_bondissuer ,bond.inner_issuer_rating ,bond.maturity_date ,bond.date_exists ,bond.guarantor ,bond.guarantor_id FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo crmw ON crmw.security_type = 'crmw' AND crmw.security_status != 'D'
AND bond.security_type NOT IN ('crmw', 'company') AND bond.security_status != 'D' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status_crmw ips WHERE ips.security_code = bond.wind_code AND ips.crmw_scode = crmw.wind_code AND ips.crmw_stype = 'crmw' AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.pool_type = 'crmw' )
AND bond.wind_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityCode}, '%')
AND bond.short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityShortName}, '%')
AND crmw.wind_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{crmwScode}, '%')
AND crmw.short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{crmwName}, '%')
AND (
bond.wind_code_sh IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_sh != '' bond.wind_code_sz IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_sz != '' bond.wind_code_nib IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_nib != '' bond.wind_code_bj IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_bj != '' bond.wind_code_nbc IS NOT NULL AND bond.wind_code_nbc != '' bond.security_type = 'company' 1 = 0
)
ORDER BY crmw.wind_code ASC ,bond.wind_code ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.id = #{poolId} AND p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.pool_type = 'crmw' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 )

SELECT al.id ,al.security_code ,al.crmw_scode ,al.crmw_stype ,al.adjust_type ,al.adjust_mode ,al.adjust_batch_no ,al.target_pool_id ,al.flow_id ,al.flow_key ,al.audit_status ,al.adjuster_id ,al.adjust_reason ,al.adjust_advice ,al.submit_time FROM ip_adjust_log al INNER JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(adjust_batch_no) >= 25 THEN LEFT(adjust_batch_no, 21) ELSE LEFT(adjust_batch_no, 18) END AS batch_prefix FROM ip_adjust_log WHERE adjuster_id = #{adjusterId} AND adjust_type = '手动批量调整' AND pool_type = 'crmw' AND audit_status NOT IN ('-1', '99') AND is_deleted = 0 AND submit_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND) ORDER BY submit_time DESC ,id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(al.adjust_batch_no) >= 25 THEN LEFT(al.adjust_batch_no, 21) ELSE LEFT(al.adjust_batch_no, 18) END = latest.batch_prefix WHERE al.adjuster_id = #{adjusterId} AND al.adjust_type = '手动批量调整' AND al.pool_type = 'crmw' AND al.audit_status NOT IN ('-1', '99') AND al.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY al.crmw_scode ASC ,al.security_code ASC ,al.target_pool_id ASC ,al.id ASC
